description: Implement The Insight transition: after Scene011 completes, bridge cinematic canvas to DOM-based product experience with a single premium editorial statement
steps:
1. Add insight section HTML to index.html: inside
, add
containing a single

[Core Insight Statement]

. Initially hidden via CSS (opacity: 0).

2. Create css/insight.css with premium editorial styling: .insight-section is full viewport height, flexbox centered both axes, z-index above canvas (use --z-above or higher), position: relative. .insight-statement uses clamp() for responsive sizing (from --font-size-4xl to --font-size-8xl), --font-weight-light (300), --color-text-primary, --line-height-tight, --letter-spacing-tight, generous max-width (~20ch), text-align center. Opacity/transform transition for reveal: opacity 0 -> 1 with translateY(8px) -> 0 over ~2s ease-out. @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) removes animation, text simply visible. Transition triggered by adding .insight-section--visible class.
3. Add @import './insight.css' to css/main.css after the existing @import './components.css' line.

4. Create js/sections/InsightTransition.js - a reusable bridge class. Constructor takes { engine, universe, scrollManager }. Methods: start() begins the transition sequence: (a) 1-second silence delay via setTimeout/rAF, (b) reduces universe particle motion by damping all particle velocities to ~20% over 2 seconds, (c) after motion reduction settles (~2s), adds .insight-section--visible class to #insight-section element, (d) after text appears (~2s more), calls scrollManager.unlock() to enable scrolling. Should store state (idle, transitioning, complete). Reduced motion path: skip delays, immediately show text, unlock scroll. destroy() for cleanup.

5. Create js/sections/InsightSection.js - manages the insight DOM element lifecycle. Constructor takes no args, uses document.getElementById('insight-section'). Methods: reveal() adds the --visible class, hide() removes it, isVisible() getter, destroy(). Simple, lightweight, no animation engine.

6. Modify js/engine/Engine.js: (a) import InsightTransition from '../sections/InsightTransition.js', (b) add insightTransition property initialized to null in constructor, (c) add insightTriggered = false property, (d) in checkSceneTransition(), after the Scene010->Scene011 block, add a new block: if scene011 is current and scene011Instance.isCompleted() and !insightTriggered, set insightTriggered = true and call this.triggerInsightTransition(), (e) add triggerInsightTransition() method that creates new InsightTransition({ engine: this, universe: this.universe, scrollManager: this.managers.get('scroll') }) and calls .start(), (f) also tell Scene011 to skipEnvironmentTeardown so the universe canvas stays.

7. Update Engine.js init() method: after all scenes are initialized but before setting state to READY, lock scroll via this.managers.get('scroll').lock() so scroll is disabled during cinematic. InsightTransition.start() will unlock it after the insight text appears.
acceptance_criteria: Running NODE_OPTIONS='' node --check on all JS files (Engine.js, InsightTransition.js, InsightSection.js) passes with no syntax errors
index.html contains a semantic <section id='insight-section'> inside <main> with one paragraph element for the statement
css/insight.css exists with responsive typography using design tokens from variables.css
Engine.js detects Scene011 completion and triggers InsightTransition
InsightTransition reduces universe motion and reveals text in DOM via CSS class toggle
ScrollManager is locked during cinematic and unlocked after insight text appears
Reduced motion is respected - no animation, text simply visible immediately
No new animation engine, no canvas text rendering, no extra sections, no navigation
verification: Verify HTML well-formedness with node -e to parse index.html
findings: All JS files pass node --check syntax validation. HTML well-formedness verified. InsightTransition reduces particle motion via per-particle vx/vy damping over 2s with cubic ease-out. ScrollManager locked during cinematic in init(), unlocked by InsightTransition after text settles. Reduced motion path skips all delays and immediately reveals text + unlocks scroll. No new animation engine. Universe canvas persists as quiet backdrop via skipEnvironmentTeardown on Scene011.
